tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H≈0.28–0.45, whereas the target is H=20. A slow-horizon probe can distinguish persistent positive gain from endogenous long-term reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon adaptation from pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations cannot reliably identify the slow component needed for a forecast at H=20.
The immediate ambiguity concerns long-horizon reversal, not fine short-time dynamics.
The pilot signatures point to temporal adaptation rather than a static branch ambiguity.
It does not resolve the forecast-horizon ambiguity.
